actions.description: The Project Charter establishes clear strategic purpose, sponsor authority, measurable objectives aligned with benefits, and realistic scope boundaries -- approve it to proceed to project execution and subsidiary planning
The Project Charter has fundamental flaws in authority, objectives, or scope alignment that cannot be reconciled -- reject it outright
The Project Charter requires clarification of measurable objectives, sponsor boundaries, or premature subsidiary commitments before a final decision can be made

metadata.decision_context: Governance review for Stage 2 Project Charter

complexity_profile.rationale: Reused directly from sidpa-template's own shared-complexity-profile.json, which itself was corrected from a real ADPA mistake (approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
